keep_features.evidence_span: Help Protect Children From Gun Violence

keep_features.evidence_span: "Protect Children From Gun Violence" -> "Protect Children From Government Overreach on Gun Rights"
keep_features.rationale: The mirror retargets the problem from violence to government overreach regarding gun rights.
